subject.title: fix(qa): separate provider plans from runtime calls

question: Should this protected QA release-gate repair land with the current transcript-only classifier after the full parity-report path is reviewed, and should its `CHANGELOG.md` edit be removed from the normal PR?
rationale: The PR is member-authored, protected by the `maintainer` label, and changes how release QA decides whether a runtime tool result exists; supplied excerpts are insufficient to settle the intended release-gate contract without owner review.

options.title: Review and land the focused QA repair
options.body: Confirm transcript capture is authoritative in all report consumers and remove the release-owned changelog edit before merging.

options.title: Keep mock-plan fallback
options.body: Retain or redesign a fallback only if maintainers can name a runtime-capture contract that requires it without letting planned calls become persisted runtime evidence.

options.title: Pause for release-QA contract clarification
options.body: Defer the change if the team has not agreed whether a missing transcript record should fail parity independently of provider-plan diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Review and land the focused QA repair
recommendation.body: Confirm transcript capture is authoritative in all report consumers and remove the release-owned changelog edit before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history ties this member directly to the focused QA parity implementation and review assignment.
